measurement: Read-only production query through the deployed public Game Review projection under the current environment.

authorization_projection.note: Event counts include all projected authorized events; selected chapter counts include only the plan chapters. Eligibility uses the public safe plan, never the raw stored plan.

locks.eligibility: An unreviewed analyzed player-owned game whose stored GameTeachingPlan survives the current public projection and contains at least one selected chapter.
locks.preview_cap: Inherit the already-measured GameTeachingPlan cap; do not add a selector-specific cap.
locks.dismissal: No timed cooldown is introduced. A dismissed prescription stays excluded in V1; if the eligible pool is exhausted, return an honest empty state.
locks.source_preference: Not locked. All currently eligible games are imported games, so the corpus cannot discriminate an imported-versus-coach tie-breaker.
